official_alert.headline: High winds and heavy rain are expected today. This may cause delays, detours or service suspensions. Please allow extra travel time. Check septa.org/alerts for the latest information and use plan.septa.org to find alternate routes. We encourage Regional Rail riders to familiarize themselves with designated alternate bus and Metro routes in case of disruptions.
